news.title: Tether putting $23 billion gold stockpile to work with bullion-backed loans
news.summary: The stablecoin issuer is extending its tokenized gold strategy by allowing holders of XAUT to borrow against their bullion, mirroring bitcoin-backed lending without selling the underlying asset.

news.title: Polymarket hack updated to $3.1 million days after the platform promised users full refunds
news.summary: The prediction markets giant is under investigation in connection with false or deceptive marketing practices, according to news reports.

news.title: Coinbase and OKX try to lure in Binance’s EU users after it failed to secure a MiCA license
news.summary: Brian Armstrong of Coinbase and Star Xu of OKX offered new users sign up bonuses of up to 8% of their deposits or transfers from other accounts.

news.title: Binance founder CZ blames crypto's sour 2026 on mix of AI, global tension, 4-year cycle
news.summary: There is no single cause for the crypto market's 50% decline over the past year, the Binance founder told CoinDesk.

news.title: Strategy's valuation has fallen below the value of its bitcoin holdings
news.summary: For years, investors had valued the firm well above its bitcoin holdings, giving Strategy massive flexibility to raise capital as needed — a situation Michael Saylor and team took full advantage of.

news.title: Ripple CEO stays bullish on bitcoin but says Saylor's strategy has hurt crypto
news.summary: Ripple's Brad Garlinghouse called Strategy's preferred-stock funding model "financial engineering" that distracted the market, pointing to STRC's slide to a record low as the evidence. He runs the company behind XRP, a bitcoin rival.

news.title: Dogecoin and Hyperliquid's HYPE led weekly crypto losses as AI stocks lure buyers
news.summary: A rotation out of chipmakers lifted much of the stock market, with the equal-weight S&P 500 at a record. Crypto was not part of it. Ether fell 8% on the week and the memecoins dropped harder.

news.title: Aave, Solana ecosystem tokens lead crypto rebound as bitcoin steadies near $60,000
news.summary: Tokenized stock trading fueled fresh momentum across the Solana ecosystem, while Aave founder hinted at token buybacks coming under new framework.

news.title: After losing my son, would it be a mistake to sell my recently purchased house and move to my hometown?
news.summary: “I raised my children there as a single mother, and it was the last home my son lived in before he passed away unexpectedly.”

news.title: ‘She is retired’: Do I dip into my 401(k) to pay my mother’s $30,000 credit-card debt?
news.summary: “I want her to live on her Social Security instead of using it to pay off her credit-card debt.”

news.title: I’m a CPA and tell my clients to claim Social Security early. Am I giving them bad advice?
news.summary: “Only 8% to 10% of people wait until age 70 to claim.”

news.title: AI turbocharged the stock market. Now it’s firing up the economy.
news.summary: A modern-day gold rush is giving a big boost to U.S. GDP.

news.title: Going back to the office may actually be better for you than working from home
news.summary: Returning to the office — even just a few days a week — might be what fully remote workers actually need.

news.title: Big Tech is obsessed with smart glasses. Now it has to convince people to wear them.
news.summary: Smart glasses could become the definitive hardware design of the AI era — if consumers buy in to the idea.

news.title: ‘I’ll happily wait’: Does delaying Social Security make sense for high earners like me?
news.summary: “In many states, Social Security benefits are exempt from state income tax.”
